title: CobbledWaves
description: A Modpack needed to play on the CobbledWaves Minecraft server.
body:
![Yez](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/40cfd2d8ed45333bce70b258688de6bff9d906d7.png)

## —  A Feature Packed Cobblemon Modpack —

![Divider](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5071917298f6bf8a917aee81f6ba7c11b0f3667e.webp)

## —  Features —

**_BadgeBoxes_** - Store your Badges safely                                                      
**_All the mons_** - Adds over 200+ new Pokémons                                                 
**_Baby Legends_** - Adds baby versions of Legendary Pokémons                                    
**_Blue's Cobblemon Utilities_** - Adds Gender-Benders (Changes Pokémons Genders) and Adds a Item which turns your Pokémons Shiny                                                          
**_CobbleCuisine_** - Adds a ton of new foods and drinks for you AND your pokémons which gives you a ton of boosts                                                                            
**_CobbledStops_** - Adds Pokéstops from Pokémon go that give a huge variety of loot)           
**_CobbleDollars_** - Adds a new type of Currency that lets you purchase items from villagers with the new Profession                                                                        
**_Alpha Project_** - Adds Alpha Pokémons which are bigger stronger versions of normal pokémons                                                                                        
**_Autobattle_** - Allows you to turn on "Auto Battle" and battle without having to move a finger                                                                                          
**_Fossil Hybrids_** - Adds more features to Fossils letting you "fuse" two diffrent fossils together creating a stronger version of those two pokémons                              
**_Mass outbreaks_** - Adds outbreaks from Pokémon Scarlet/Violet                                
**_Raid Dens_** - Adds Raid Dens which are mini boss battles giving you loot and pokémons for defeating the boss                                                                              

![Divider](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5071917298f6bf8a917aee81f6ba7c11b0f3667e.webp)
